description: Systems lack resilience to withstand and recover from incidents affecting personal data processing. Resilience encompasses the ability to maintain operations during disruptions, adapt to changing conditions, and recover quickly from failures or attacks.
applicability: Applicable to all systems processing personal data. Includes fault tolerance, graceful degradation, incident response capabilities, backup systems, and ability to operate under adverse conditions such as attacks or infrastructure failures.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through architecture review and disaster recovery testing. Look for lack of error handling, no graceful degradation, missing circuit breakers, single points of failure, no incident response plan, inadequate redundancy, and absence of chaos engineering or resilience testing. Review ability to operate during DDoS attacks or system failures.
